overview_description.description: ​​Searchlight's Predictive Talent Platform provides assessments and analytics help companies improve hiring efficiency and effectiveness. Searchlight’s powerful People Science Engine measures and improves Quality of Hire by connecting candidate reference and self-assessment data to post-hire outcomes. Searchlight’s connected talent intelligence system pulls employee outcome data – such as enablement, performance, belonging– back into the recruiting process to surface predictive signals like competencies and soft skills. These real-time insights enable organizations to continuously learn as they hire and retain the right people. Searchlight is on a people-first mission to make hiring a win-win for everyone by understanding talent better.

about_short_description.short_description: A Predictive Talent Platform that improves hiring efficiency & Quality of Hire by connecting talent assessments & analytics to outcomes

product.name: Applicant Screening
product.description: An AI-driven tool that filters and ranks candidates based on relevant work experience, hard skills, and soft skills to identify top applicants quickly and reduce manual resume review.

product.name: Assessments
product.description: A digital survey-based assessment that evaluates candidates’ skills, culture fit, and behavioral attributes predictive of job performance, customizable by job family and organization.

product.name: Reference Checks
product.description: An automated reference checking service that collects predictive data on candidates’ skills, culture, and potential performance to support faster hiring and better onboarding.

product.name: Quality of Hire
product.description: A software solution that measures and tracks the quality of hires using validated formulas, providing executive-level metrics and continuous improvement through automated data analysis.

product.name: TRACY AI Talent Partner
product.description: An AI system that integrates applicant screening, assessments, reference checks, and quality of hire measurement to continuously improve hiring decisions based on organizational data and people science.
